name: Cannabis Coconut Oil
desc: Decarboxylate, then infuse into coconut oil with lecithin. Adults only, dose carefully

ingredients.raw: 7 grams dry cannabis flower, or 3 grams hash
ingredients.item: dry cannabis flower, or 3 grams hash

ingredients.raw: 1/4 to 1/2 cup melted coconut oil (use less for a more concentrated oil)
ingredients.item: melted coconut oil (use less for a more concentrated oil)

ingredients.raw: Equipment: an oven-safe Pyrex dish or double boiler, foil or an oven bag, a candy thermometer, and a wide-mouth jar for storage

steps: Grind the cannabis and preheat the oven to 220F.
Decarboxylate first, which is what activates the THC. Spread the ground flower in the Pyrex dish no thicker than 1/2 to 3/4 inch so the heat reaches all of it. Use multiple dishes for larger amounts.
If using hash, break it into chunks and sprinkle evenly. For concentrates, preheat the dish for a few minutes first, then spread the extract thin.
Wrap the dish in foil or seal it in an oven bag and heat 20 to 30 minutes. Older herb needs 15 to 20 minutes, a freshly dried crop 30 to 45.
Heat the coconut oil in a saucepan until it is just too warm to touch, ideally over 200F on the candy thermometer.
Pour the hot oil over the decarboxylated material, stir in the soy lecithin, reseal, and hold at low heat for 1 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Strain through cheesecloth into a wide-mouth jar, pressing to get everything out. Store cool and dark.
Potency varies a lot batch to batch. Start with a very small amount and wait a full two hours before taking any more.
